cast.character: Eric Cartman / Stan Marsh /  Randy Marsh / Mr. Garrison (voice)

cast.name: 马特·斯通
cast.character: Kyle Broflovski / Kenny McCormick / Butters Stotch (voice)

tmdb-tv-2190.title: 南方公园
tmdb-tv-2190.overview: 讲述科罗拉多州南方公园小镇上，斯坦、凯尔、卡特曼和肯尼四个孩子的生活。他们不断卷入超自然事件、社会冲突和各种荒诞危机，并以孩子的视角面对成年人世界中的政治、宗教、文化和社会问题。

tmdb-tv-300146.title: 嫁金钗
tmdb-tv-300146.overview: 改编自笑佳人的同名小说。阿丑因容貌酷似侯府千金，意外成为国公府世子陆濯的冲喜新娘。陆濯苏醒后对她百般提防，另一名与她容貌相同的女子也对她恨之入骨。身处危机四伏的国公府，阿丑步步谋划，逐渐改写命运，并揭开身世之谜。

tmdb-tv-284833.title: 降世神通：七净土
tmdb-tv-284833.overview: 灾难性的巨变摧毁了世界，一名年轻的土御术师发现自己是科拉之后的新一任神通。然而，在这个危险的时代，人们视神通为人类的毁灭者，而非救世主。遭到人类与灵体追捕的她，必须与失散多年的双胞胎姐妹联手，揭开身世之谜，并在文明最后的避难所彻底崩溃前拯救七净土。

tmdb-tv-288673.title: 魔女嘉莉
tmdb-tv-288673.overview: 父亲的突然离世迫使嘉莉进入到了残酷的公立高中，她不得不面对席卷社区的校园霸凌丑闻、社交媒体时代无情的压力和冷酷无情，以及伴随青春期而觉醒的神秘心灵感应能力。

tmdb-movie-1117898.title: 戴帽子的猫
tmdb-movie-1117898.overview: 戴帽子的“猫”一角由比尔·哈德尔配音——展现他那招牌的幽默、独特方式为孩子带来欢乐，带领观众踏上一段奇幻的旅程，进入一个前所未见的世界。 　　在本片中，我们的英雄接下了想像力与灵感研究所有限责任公司迄今最艰钜的任务：为盖比和赛巴斯汀这对姐弟加油打气，他们正为搬到新城镇而苦恼。对这位过去以行事过激而闻名的闯祸精来说，这可能是他证明自己的最后机会……否则他就会失去他的魔法帽！

related.title: 征服14座高峰：凡事皆有可能

tmdb-movie-1603262.title: 珠穆朗玛：云中彼岸
tmdb-movie-1603262.overview: 真实记录登山滑雪运动员吉姆·莫里森于2025年10月成功沿珠穆朗玛峰北坡霍恩拜因雪沟登顶，并成为全球首位在该危险路线完成滑雪速降的历史性壮举。

tmdb-movie-925725.title: 霹雳英雄：素还真
tmdb-movie-925725.overview: 少年素还真身怀绝艺，初入江湖原想见识广大世界，却因为新结识的好友卷入了险恶的夺权纷争，就连他的老师都因他遭难。

tmdb-movie-1531919.title: 白衣逆行者
tmdb-movie-1531919.overview: 影片取材自真实事件，76天紧迫与焦灼的记忆，又在眼前重现。 　　灾难之下，城市陷入危机，病毒反复、资源告急，困境加剧。展现危急时刻众生相，有人一往无前奔赴前线，有人在泥沼中奋力生存，也有人倒下，有人坚守。76 天后解封，汽笛划破长空。这段历史，没有人是旁观者，我们都在时代褶皱里彼此托举，共同度过了艰难时刻。

tmdb-movie-1567259.title: 试探
tmdb-movie-1567259.overview: 为了测试男友丁伯阳对自己的爱，万影策划了一场失踪事件，让丁伯阳陷入短暂的痛苦中。此时，年轻惹火的马娅趁机上位，与丁伯阳光速热恋，激情同居。可马娅不知道的是，打从自己搬进丁伯阳家的一刻起，自己也成为了这场试探游戏的危险玩家之一…

tmdb-movie-1409470.title: 我们仅有一次的人生
tmdb-movie-1409470.overview: 身患绝症的女火化师黄燕在工作中误将两份骨灰弄错，当她坦白真相，两家人竟都不愿换回，唯有其中一位死者的女儿姚雪相信黄燕，两人结伴踏上疯狂而荒诞的换骨灰之路，重新理解生命，向死而生。

related.title: 安娜·妮可·史密斯：你们不了解我

tmdb-movie-1529692.title: 夫妻一场
tmdb-movie-1529692.overview: 相识于原博的还俗派对时，李欣冉还是位身患抑郁症的女演员。处于人生低谷的俩人一见钟情，他们迅速走到一起，迎来第一个孩子。带着几百万积蓄，他们憧憬着理想生活，却因挥霍和缺乏理财经验，陷入了经济危机。为扭转困境，原博计划在安吉山中创办手碟乐器工厂。青山绿水似乎是他们梦想中的乌托邦。然而，随着第二个孩子的降生，事业夭折，合伙人离开，债务缠身。日常琐碎与经济压力逐渐蚕食了曾经炙热的感情。在深山中，他们爱到一无所有，只剩彼此。

tmdb-movie-1807721.title: 手捧繁星
tmdb-movie-1807721.overview: 影片以援疆教师姚思平与学生艾迪娜、斯塔拉的十年命运羁绊为主线，融合温暖治愈与轻度悬疑元素——既有师生相互救赎的动人瞬间，也有年轻人直面人生困境的成长，延续《我的阿勒泰》对“心灵治愈”的探索，兼具情感温度与现实深度。

tmdb-movie-1810158.title: 心迷宫之三重罪
tmdb-movie-1810158.overview: 一具烧焦的无名尸体被发现，引发邻里间的猜疑。大家都在怀疑小肖杀人，虎子的家人企图认尸躲避恶霸追债，琴儿则借尸体摆脱已无感情的丈夫，此时，又有一场意外发生………随着警方调查，真相逐渐浮现。

tmdb-movie-1812386.title: 向阳青春
tmdb-movie-1812386.overview: 高中生夏薇零（肖雨晴 饰），长期困在母亲（李颖 饰） 的严密管控里，学业、选择、交友全都被安排妥当。曾经顺从的她，终于在压抑里爆发，逃课、反抗，和好友宋飞（张恒铭 饰）、陆欢（张婧岚 饰）一起，拼命夺回属于自己的空间。母女之间争吵不断，误会层层叠加，那句沉甸甸的 “我都是为了你”，慢慢变成刺伤彼此的利刃。一边是母亲寄托全部人生的期待，一边是女孩想要自主成长的渴望。这场没有赢家的家庭战争，能否找到和解的出口？这是属于无数青春期孩子的挣扎，也是每个家长都要面对的一课。

tmdb-tv-243875.title: 乔治和曼迪的头婚生活
tmdb-tv-243875.overview: 《小谢尔顿》的衍生剧集。乔治和曼迪在德克萨斯州抚养他们的年轻家庭，同时应对成年、育儿和婚姻的挑战。

tmdb-tv-75219.title: 紧急呼救
tmdb-tv-75219.overview: 这部剧讲述了包括警察、消防员和调遣员在内的急救人员的高压经历，他们遇到的最可怕、令人震惊和惊心动魄的情境。这些急救人员必须努力在拯救最脆弱的人与解决他们自己生活中的问题之间取得平衡。该节目取材于生活中急救人员经常面临的难以预料的、令人紧张却又振奋人心的现实事件。

tmdb-tv-2734.title: 法律与秩序：特殊受害者
tmdb-tv-2734.overview: 被残忍杀害的年轻女子、被虐的婴儿、被近亲性侵害的女童、家暴阴影下手足无措的妇女、失调扭曲的家庭关系、很想用心但每每力有未迨的父母、杵在社会家庭人际边缘人性的灰色地带。SVU每回总是触动那块让人无从防备的柔软地带，可爱的孩童，无辜的弱势个体（受性侵害者、同性恋、精神病患），每个人都多少有些经验感触的亲子、家庭关系。不见得得是多复杂的剧情，像今天，忙于工作单亲母亲剧烈摇晃死自己的一岁多幼女(Shake Syndrome)，幼小无辜的女孩在母亲一时的暴怒下被辗压击碎，但另一方面你多了解那种拉扯在工作亲子关系中的心力交瘁，可爱时像天使哭闹起来却像恶魔一样让你抓狂的孩子，要怎么以审判指控那、为了不舍得看到无恢复希望的孩子继续受到病痛折磨而毅然决定停止呼吸器，哪怕这将使自己已因杀罪被起诉的母亲？是以就算这是再滥情的一种搬演、操控，每每总还是让观众溃不成军...

tmdb-tv-549.title: 法律与秩序
tmdb-tv-549.overview: 本片融警匪与法庭于一体的电视剧，片中讲述的犯罪基本原于真实生活，往往是近期报纸上的头条新闻。节目分为两部分，上半部分介绍警察研究现场，征询证人，提审嫌疑犯等一系列的侦破活动，后半部分详尽记录了案件侦破的后期工作，案件转交到检查官手里，检查官衡量案情，起诉，直到庭审，节奏紧凑，扣人心弦。由于最终坏人不一定被绳之于法，所以观众看的时候往往暗自捏一把汗。

tmdb-tv-1416.title: 实习医生格蕾
tmdb-tv-1416.overview: 西雅图格雷斯医院迎来新一批实习生，梅雷迪斯·格雷、克里斯蒂娜·杨、伊泽贝尔·斯蒂文、乔治·梅利 、亚里克斯·卡莱，五个医学院好友同期毕业，需要以良好表现争夺住院医师正式席位。进入医院伊始，梅雷迪斯崩溃地发现前晚在酒吧和她发生一夜情的男人，竟然是神经外科医生德立克·舍伯，两人纠葛就此开始；克里斯蒂娜吸引了胸外科医师普雷斯顿·伯克的注意，因为他们同样高傲和野心勃勃；乔治悄悄爱着梅雷迪斯；美丽的伊泽贝尔第一时间掀起流言，一年的实习期注定充满高密度的压力竞争与荷尔蒙……

tmdb-tv-313630.title: 永属于你
tmdb-tv-313630.overview: 一部讲述永恒爱情的故事，讲述了一对结婚已有五百年之久的吸血鬼夫妇，以及他们努力接受与自己女儿交往的人类男子的经历。

tmdb-tv-284838.title: 紧急呼救：纳什维尔
tmdb-tv-284838.overview: 故事设定在美国最多元、最有活力的城市之一纳什维尔，聚焦于英勇的第一线应急救护人员，也深入他们充满权力与魅力的家族故事。

tmdb-tv-298852.title: 律界战争
tmdb-tv-298852.overview: 两家伦敦顶级律所围绕一场轰动全城的离婚案展开较量。随着案件升级，野心、背叛与利益交织，每个人都不惜一切争取胜利。

tmdb-tv-303630.title: 库比蒂诺
tmdb-tv-303630.overview: 一名律师遭前雇主科技初创公司侵吞股票期权。他拒绝妥协，与另一名刚被解雇的律师联手创办律所，帮助遭科技巨头侵害的人们维权，向掌控硅谷的强大企业发起挑战。

tmdb-tv-253391.title: 治安官之乡
tmdb-tv-253391.overview: 《烈焰国度》衍生剧。直率的治安官米奇・福克斯驻守埃奇沃特小镇，巡逻侦办罪案，同时兼顾家庭难题。她既要面对有前科、私种大麻的父亲韦斯，也要守护宣誓捍卫的社区，应对持续升级的犯罪危机。

tmdb-tv-202297.title: 烈焰国度
tmdb-tv-202297.overview: Bode Donovan 是一名年轻罪犯，曾经烧毁了他生命中的一切。为寻求救赎，Bode 加入了北加州一项非常规的监狱释放消防计划，在那里他和其他囚犯以及精英消防员合作扑灭不可预测的大规模火势， 这是项高风险、高回报的任务。当 Bode 被分配到他家乡小镇的项目之后， 五年前留下的秘密也逐渐揭开。

tmdb-tv-256711.title: 造雨人
tmdb-tv-256711.overview: 改编自约翰·格里森姆的同名小说。年轻律师鲁迪·贝勒与布鲁瑟·斯通、迪克·希夫莱特联手，在复杂的法律纠纷中挑战强大势力，揭露案件背后的阴谋，在法庭上为委托人争取正义。

tmdb-tv-284736.title: 警察世家：波士顿
tmdb-tv-284736.overview: 《警察世家：波士顿》是由CBS制作的制作的剧集，讲述前纽约警局探员丹尼·里根在一起涉及其小儿子肖恩的案件后，转而加入波士顿警局。他与莉娜·西尔弗搭档——她出身当地著名警察世家，是家中长女，也是前途无量的“明日之星”。她的祖父彼得斯牧师是波士顿一所历史悠久的浸信会教堂里颇具声望的宗教领袖；他同时是波士顿地区检察官梅·西尔弗的父亲，以及警局总监莎拉·西尔弗（最初称为阿什莉）和新晋巡警乔纳·西尔弗（最初称为艾萨克）的外祖父。

tmdb-tv-207484.title: 古战场传奇：吾血之亲
tmdb-tv-207484.overview: 《古战场传奇：吾血之亲》是《古战场传奇》的前传。讲述杰米·弗雷泽和克莱尔·博尚的父母在不同时代的爱情故事。18世纪的苏格兰高地，艾伦与布莱恩冲破家族阻碍相爱；20世纪的欧洲，亨利与朱莉娅因战争相遇。两段跨越时代的爱情，共同揭开弗雷泽家族的过去。

tmdb-tv-253896.title: 幸福之地
tmdb-tv-253896.overview: 鲍比 (丽巴饰) 从她已故的父亲那里继承了一家餐馆，然后她得知自己必须与新发现的同父异母的妹妹共享所有权，两人之间产生了尴尬的紧张关系。

tmdb-tv-322267.title: Newlyweds
tmdb-tv-322267.overview: A later-in-life love story about a free-spirited woman and a buttoned-up professor who marry impetuously after a whirlwind courtship.

tmdb-tv-1952.title: 神秘科学剧院时刻
tmdb-tv-1952.overview: 在不久的将来，乔尔·罗宾逊被福雷斯特博士和电视人弗兰克囚禁，被迫在“爱之卫星”上观看B级电影，他的机器人朋友坎博特、吉普赛、汤姆·塞尔沃和克劳·T·机器人将陪伴他观看。

tmdb-tv-1054.title: The Young and the Restless
tmdb-tv-1054.overview: The Young and the Restless revolves around the rivalries, romances, hopes and fears of the residents of the fictional Midwestern metropolis, Genoa City. The lives and loves of a wide variety of characters mingle through the generations, dominated by the Newman, Abbott, Chancellor, Baldwin and Winters families. ­ When The Young and the Restless premiered in 1973, it revolutionized the daytime drama. It continues to set the standard with strong characters, socially conscious storylines, romance and sensuality.

tmdb-tv-6647.title: 大胆而美丽
tmdb-tv-6647.overview: 持续的戏剧融合了浪漫与阴谋，背景是比佛利山庄和美国时尚产业的璀璨背景。

tmdb-tv-987.title: 综合医院
tmdb-tv-987.overview: General Hospital, which celebrated its golden anniversary on April 1, 2013, continues its tradition of passion, intrigue and adventure that takes place in the fictional town of Port Charles in upstate New York. The glamour and excitement of those who have come to find their destinies in this familiar seaport town intertwine with the lives, loves and fortunes of beloved, well-known faces. As always, love, danger and mind blowing plot twists continue to abound on General Hospital with contemporary storylines and unforgettable characters.

tmdb-tv-881.title: 我们的日子
tmdb-tv-881.overview: 本剧主要描述两个家庭：荷顿(Hortons)家族和布雷迪(Bradys)家族。 很多其他家族也进入到这个团队，并且偶尔露面。荷顿家族的女家长，Frances Reid从该剧成立以来一直参与演出直到2010年2月3日逝世。 Suzanne Rogers在我们的日子38周年庆生会中，回顾她第一次于1973年出场。 Susan Seaforth Hayes 则是唯一的从开播到现在都还在的角色。

tmdb-tv-248361.title: 大门之外
tmdb-tv-248361.overview: 一个权势显赫的家族统治着一个豪华的封闭式社区，这里隐藏着诸多引人入胜的秘密和丑闻，等待着被揭开。

tmdb-tv-92408.title: 深夜食堂：东京故事
tmdb-tv-92408.overview: 在一间朴实无华的日本餐厅中，几名食客因为对于特定菜品的钟情而建立了一种简单而深刻的心灵之交。

tvdb-show-320423.title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
tvdb-show-320423.overview: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

tmdb-tv-231801.title: 极道寿司次郎！
tmdb-tv-231801.overview: 故事背景为近未来的洛杉矶，整座城市被“美食秩序”彻底掌控：顶级主厨的权势堪比黑帮大佬，餐厅就是各方势力的权力中心，为了拿下顶级餐厅的一席位，有人不惜突破底线，不同的烹饪理念更是分化出针锋相对的派系。

tmdb-tv-79481.title: 斗破苍穹
tmdb-tv-79481.overview:
萧炎曾是家族里公认的斗气天才，年仅11岁便已经抵达了常人穷尽一生都无法修炼到的境界。可12岁那年，一场意外让萧炎的全部努力都化为了乌有，失去一切的他体会到了人情的冷暖和世态的炎凉，之后，萧炎和纳兰嫣然许下了决斗的三年之约，来到魔兽山脉，在身世神秘的药老手下修炼。三年间，萧炎的身影穿梭在塔戈尔大沙漠和加玛帝国黑岩城等地，结识了云芝、小医仙等志同道合的好友，并且最终获得了强大的力量。三年一晃眼就过去了，萧炎毫无悬念的战胜了纳兰嫣然，却没想到，他的故事和劫难才刚刚开始。

剧情发展观看顺序：特别篇4（缘起篇）- 第一季 - 特别篇1（邂逅云芝篇）- 第二季 - 特别篇2（沙之澜歌）- 第三季 - 第四季 - 特别篇3（三年之约）- 第五季（年番）

tvdb-show-478752.title: Overgeared
tvdb-show-478752.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

tmdb-tv-216467.title: 夜樱家的大作战
tmdb-tv-216467.overview:
「这个家庭非比寻常！？」　

高中生「朝野太阳」，因为事故而痛失了家人，心灵也因此变得十分封闭。在班上的同学，大家对他的印象都是”超．内向”，唯一能够与之交谈的是他的青梅竹马「夜樱六美」，但是六美却有一个秘密！？

她的真实身份是代代相传的间谍家族的当家，还一直受到各种敌人性命的威胁。而且她的哥哥「凶一郎」是最凶狠的间谍，对六美表现出异常的溺爱。太阳发现，自己已经成为凶一郎“排除”的目标，生命岌岌可危…！

为了守护六美以及自己的性命安全，太阳采取的手段居然是与六美结婚，成为夜樱家的女婿！？

围绕着太阳、六美以及夜樱家前所未闻的「大作战」让人目不转睛！

tvdb-show-459942.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
tvdb-show-459942.original_title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
tvdb-show-459942.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

tmdb-tv-223911.title: 仙逆
tmdb-tv-223911.overview: 改编自耳根同名小说《仙逆》，讲述了乡村平凡少年王林以心中之感动，逆仙而修，求的不仅是长生，更多的是摆脱那背后的蝼蚁之身。他坚信道在人为，以平庸的资质踏入修真仙途，历经坎坷风雨，凭着其聪睿的心智，一步一步走向巅峰，凭一己之力，扬名修真界。

tvmaze-episode-3790324.title: Where the Mask Ends
tvmaze-episode-3790324.overview: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

tvdb-show-475347.title: Dive into You
tvdb-show-475347.overview: Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

tvmaze-episode-3772771.title: Fool in Love
tvmaze-episode-3772771.overview: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

tvmaze-episode-3784575.title: The Lament of Autumn
tvmaze-episode-3784575.overview: In the turbulent 1920s, Yu Changxuan and Ye Pingjun fall into a love-hate entanglement, defying war and fate together.

imdb-tt0096697.title: The Simpsons
imdb-tt0096697.overview: The Simpsons is the longest running scripted show in US television history. It captures the adventures of Homer, Marge, Maggie, Bart and Lisa who are living in a fictional town called Springfield.

tmdb-tv-290856.title: Marshals
tmdb-tv-290856.overview: Marshals stars Luke Grimes reprising his role as Kayce Dutton. With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana. Kayce and his teammates - Pete Calvin, Belle Skinner, Andrea Cruz and Miles Kittle - must balance the high psychological cost of serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence with their duty to their families, which for Kayce includes his son Tate and his confidants Thomas Rainwater and Mo from the Broken Rock reservation.

imdb-tt4406178.title: The Gilded Age
imdb-tt4406178.overview: The American Gilded Age was a period of immense economic change, of huge fortunes made and lost, and the rise of disparity between old money and new.Against this backdrop of change, the story begins in 1882 — introducing young Marian Brook, the orphaned daughter of a Union general, who moves into the New York City home of her thoroughly old money aunts Agnes van Rhijn and Ada Brook. Accompanied by Peggy Scott, an accomplished African-American woman, Marian inadvertently becomes enmeshed in a social war between one of her aunts, a scion of the old money set, and her stupendously rich neighbors, a ruthless railroad tycoon and his ambitious wife, George and Bertha Russell.In this exciting new world that is on the brink of the modern age, will Marian follow the established rules of society, or forge her own path?

tmdb-tv-211288.title: Tracker
tmdb-tv-211288.overview: Tracker features lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw, who roams the country as a "reward seeker," using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement to solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

imdb-tt21376524.title: Animal Control
imdb-tt21376524.overview: Animal Control is a workplace comedy following a group of Animal Control workers whose lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not.

imdb-tt33359676.title: Maigret
imdb-tt33359676.overview: In Maigret, Chief Inspector Maigret and his team of maverick but loyal detectives, Les Maigrets, solve a series of complex crimes in Paris. Maigret's unconventional methods and unique sense of justice put him at odds with his superiors and the judicial system he is supposed to represent. Maigret must outwit some of Paris's most cunning and violent criminals, while dealing with his own troubled past.

imdb-tt30051064.title: American Hostage
imdb-tt30051064.overview: The first 8-episode installment of this anthology series is set in the 1970s. The psychological thriller tells the harrowing true story of Fred Heckman, a beloved Indianapolis radio reporter who is thrust into the middle of a life-or-death crisis when hostage-taker Tony Kiritsis demands to be interviewed on his popular radio news program.

imdb-tt40385667.title: Treasure Island
imdb-tt40385667.overview: Treasure Island charts the transformation of teenager Jim Hawkins from sheltered boy to emboldened young pirate. When Jim gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess' clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger.

imdb-tt1094229.title: Heartland
imdb-tt1094229.overview: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

imdb-tt15791752.title: Grimsburg
imdb-tt15791752.overview: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack - his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute will follow every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know.

imdb-tt35949226.title: Youth
imdb-tt35949226.overview: Youth follows a 50-year-old divorcee's search for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.

imdb-tt27458866.title: High Country
imdb-tt27458866.overview: High Country tells the story of detective Andrea Whitford who is transferred to the Victorian High Country, where she is thrust into a baffling mystery of five missing persons who have vanished into the wilderness.

imdb-tt23469464.title: Universal Basic Guys
imdb-tt23469464.overview: In Universal Basic Guys brothers Mark and Hank Hoagies suddenly find themselves with no jobs when the Glantontown Hot Dog factory switches over to automation. Lucky for them, the town started a radical Universal Basic Income pilot program, giving all residents of Glantontown $3,000 per month with no strings attached. Now, Mark, Hank and the rest of their local buddies are once again kids in the summertime, overflowing with the perilous combo of free time and stupid ideas. This is a show about men trying to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

imdb-tt37960071.title: Crossroad Springs
imdb-tt37960071.overview: Crossroad Springs follows the Hamilton family, adult siblings James and Janet, their aging family members, dad, Willis, and Aunt Amy, who are eking out a living on Hamilton Ranch with financial hardships and staffing shortages. James, a pastor in Chicago, and Janet, an ER doctor in a neighboring town, feel called to return home to help the family. Once there, the siblings encounter the son of the owner of the neighboring farm, Daniel Newman, who are all wary of each other due to a generational feud between the families. As he settles into his new day-to-day life on the farm, James begins to realize there are no places to worship on the thousands of acres of farms. There, in the environment of come-as-you-are vibes, barns, rodeo arenas, even outdoors under clear night skies, James starts a cowboy church right there in the place where faith, family, and ranch life go hand in hand.

imdb-tt15816496.title: Against the Sky Supreme
imdb-tt15816496.overview: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

imdb-tt7491982.title: FBI
imdb-tt7491982.overview: FBI is a fast-paced drama about the inner workings of the New York Field Office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. These first-class agents, including Special Agent Maggie Bell and her partner, Special Agent Omar Adom 'OA' Zidan, bring all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep New York and the country safe.

imdb-tt35515227.title: CIA
imdb-tt35515227.overview: CIA centers on two unlikely partners — a fast-talking, rule-breaking loose cannon CIA case officer, and a by-the-book, seasoned and smart FBI agent who believes in the rule of law. When this odd couple are assigned to work out of CIA's New York Station, they must learn to work together to investigate cases and criminals posing threats on U.S. soil, finding that their differences may actually be their strength.

imdb-tt1091909.title: Murdoch Mysteries
imdb-tt1091909.overview: Set in Toronto at the dawn of the 20th century, Murdoch Mysteries is a one-hour drama series that explores the intriguing world of William Murdoch, a methodical and dashing detective who pioneers innovative forensic techniques to solve some of the city's most gruesome murders. Murdoch's colleagues include the love of his life, coroner and psychiatrist Dr. Julia Ogden, a staunch ally who shares the detective's fascination for science; Constable George Crabtree, Murdoch's eager but sometimes naïve right-hand man; Inspector Brackenreid, Murdoch's skeptical yet reluctantly supportive boss; and coroner Dr. Emily Grace, Dr. Ogden's protégé.

imdb-tt21433690.title: St. Denis Medical
imdb-tt21433690.overview: St. Denis Medical is a mockumentary about an underfunded, understaffed Oregon hospital where the dedicated doctors and nurses try their best to treat patients while maintaining their own sanity.

imdb-tt36153709.title: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
imdb-tt36153709.original_title: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
imdb-tt36153709.overview: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins focuses on a disgraced former football player, who is on a mission to rehabilitate his image.

imdb-tt39957390.title: Bass X Machina
imdb-tt39957390.overview: In a lawless Steampunk West overrun by brutal outlaws, machines, and supernatural terrors, a father is forced to become judge, jury, and executioner—knowing that every act of justice meant to protect his family may ultimately cost him the very people he's fighting to save.

tvdb-show-392598.title: Swallowed Star
tvdb-show-392598.overview: One day, an unexplained RR virus appeared on the earth, drawing the world into disaster. Infected animals mutated into terrible monsters, invaded massively, and humans built walls around the destruction and established the base city as the last bastion for humans. The suffering that mankind has experienced during this period of time is known as the "Great Nirvana Period." Not only that, Luo Feng not only carried the burden of supporting the family but also to protect the human homeland, for the better survival and development of mankind, together with other justice warriors, to join hands against the fierce monsters. Under the desperate situation of the end, can Luo Feng and other warriors repel monsters and successfully protect the human world?

imdb-tt34882755.title: Wan Jie Du Zun
imdb-tt34882755.overview: Lin Feng was gathering his martial soul in the Lin Mansion. He didn't want to. His fiancee Ji Manyao took the opportunity to take his martial soul, and he almost vomited blood and died. At the same time, Lin Feng's spirit entered the land of the burial of the gods. The mysterious woman in the land of the burials told Lin Feng that he could gain enormous martial arts power and knowledge by obliterating the ancient gods buried here.

imdb-tt27617390.title: Shrouding the Heavens
imdb-tt27617390.overview: The story took the nine dragons and the coffin as an introduction and brought out a huge world of primeval ages. Climbing the sky road, and singing songs, to see how Ye Fan shrouding the heavens.

imdb-tt36885662.title: Best Medicine
imdb-tt36885662.overview: In Best Medicine a brilliant surgeon leaves Boston to become a small-town doctor where he spent childhood summers. Despite his medical skills, his rude manner alienates locals as he battles hidden phobias and struggles with personal connections.

imdb-tt26748321.title: Doc
imdb-tt26748321.overview: Doc centers on the hard-charging, brilliant Dr. Amy Larsen, Chief of Internal and Family Medicine at Westside Hospital in Minneapolis. After a brain injury erases the last eight years of her life, Amy must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves and the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience.

imdb-tt11231226.title: Reasonable Doubt
imdb-tt11231226.overview: In Reasonable Doubt, you'll judge Jax Stewart for her questionable ethics and wild interpretations of the law... until you're the one in trouble. Then you'll see her for what she is: the most brilliant and fearless defense attorney in Los Angeles who bucks the justice system at every chance she gets.

imdb-tt21952924.title: Phony
imdb-tt21952924.overview: Phony is a coming-of-age mystery about a teenager who wakes up in the hospital after a car accident to discover his mom - his only parent and his best friend - appears to have been replaced by an impostor.

imdb-tt6773088.title: Brothers
imdb-tt6773088.overview: Brothers is a heartfelt odd couple love story revolving around the strange and beautiful bond between Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson. Matthew and Woody's friendship is tested when their combined families attempt to live together on Matthew's ranch in Texas.

imdb-tt31710249.title: Stick
imdb-tt31710249.overview: Pryce Cahill is an over-the-hill, ex-pro golfer whose career was derailed prematurely 20 years ago. After the collapse of his marriage and getting fired from his job at an Indiana sporting goods store, Pryce hedges his bets, and future, entirely on a troubled 17-year-old golf phenom named Santi. Stick is a heartfelt, feel-good comedy about a found family and their relationships set within the world of golf as it's never been shown before.

imdb-tt29011445.title: Where's Wanda?
imdb-tt29011445.overview: Where's Wanda? tells the story of Dedo and Carlotta Klatt, who are desperate to locate their missing 17-year-old daughter Wanda, who disappeared months ago without a trace. When the police fail to find her, the family takes matters into their own hands, obtaining surveillance devices with the help of their tech-savvy son Ole. Disguising themselves as employees of an electrical company, they bug first their neighborhood and then half their suburb, finding out that behind closed doors none of their neighbors are who they pretend to be.

imdb-tt15483602.title: Reincarnated as a Sword
imdb-tt15483602.overview: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!

tvmaze-episode-3663290.title: The Greatest
tvmaze-episode-3663290.overview: The Greatest intimately explores the incomparable life of Muhammad Ali. The amazing victories and defeats that made Ali a legend, both in and out of the ring, have been well documented and while those landmark events will live in The Greatest, the heartbeat of the story is fueled by all the moments that took place outside of the spotlight. The world remembers an icon, but The Greatest is about a man, a husband, a father, a brother, and a son.

tmdb-tv-295778.title: Scrubs
tmdb-tv-295778.overview: Old friends JD and Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time, learning that medicine has changed; interns have changed; but their bromance has stood the test of time.

tmdb-tv-62650.title: Chicago Med
tmdb-tv-62650.overview: An emotional thrill ride through the day-to-day chaos of the city's newest state-of-the-art trauma center and into the lives of the courageous doctors, nurses and staff who hold it all together. This is one of those days.

tmdb-tv-125935.title: Abbott Elementary
tmdb-tv-125935.overview: In this workplace comedy, a group of dedicated, passionate teachers — and a slightly tone-deaf principal — are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life. Though these incredible public servants may be outnumbered and underfunded, they love what they do — even if they don't love the school district's less-than-stellar attitude toward educating children.

tmdb-tv-44006.title: Chicago Fire
tmdb-tv-44006.overview: No job is more stressful, dangerous or exhilarating than those of the Firefighters, Rescue Squad and Paramedics of Chicago Firehouse 51. These are the courageous men and women who forge headfirst into danger when everyone else is running the other way and whose actions make the difference between life and death. These are their stories.

tmdb-tv-58841.title: Chicago P.D.
tmdb-tv-58841.overview: District 21 of the Chicago Police Department is made up of two distinctly different groups. There are the uniformed cops who patrol the beat and go head to head with the city's street crimes. And there's the Intelligence Unit, the team that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond. These are their stories.

imdb-tt27995113.title: Black Doves
imdb-tt27995113.overview: Helen Webb, politician's wife, doting mother, and professional spy, has been passing on her husband's secrets to the Black Doves, the shadowy organization for whom she works. But when her lover Jason is assassinated, Helen's life is turned upside down, and only her old friend Sam Young can keep her safe. But Sam, a suave, champagne-drinking assassin, also has problems of his own. Out of the game, since his last job went wrong, he soon realizes his past is coming back to haunt him. Together, they set off on a mission that will lead them to uncover a vast, interconnected conspiracy. One that links the murky underworld of London to a looming geopolitical crisis — and leads them to question the cost of the moral choices they've made.

imdb-tt31289994.title: The Lowdown
imdb-tt31289994.overview: The Lowdown follows the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.

imdb-tt20859904.title: Mike Judge's Beavis and Butt-Head
imdb-tt20859904.overview: In this new iteration, Beavis and Butt-Head are entering a whole new Gen Z world. Comedy Central has ordered two seasons of the new series with meta-themes relatable to both new and old fans - Gen X parents and their Gen Z kids. Judge is set to write, produce and provide voice over for both iconic characters.

imdb-tt30291387.title: All's Fair
imdb-tt30291387.overview: A team of female divorce attorneys leave a male-dominated firm to open their own powerhouse practice. Fierce, brilliant, and emotionally complicated, they navigate high-stakes breakups, scandalous secrets, and shifting allegiances—both in the courtroom and within their own ranks. In a world where money talks and love is a battleground, these women don't just play the game—they change it.

mal-61469.overview:
In the 2nd STAGE, a desert crossing spanning roughly 750 miles- the land that Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli must challenge, is home to the area that is feared as the "Devil's Palm." In 1875, a threat lurking in said desert wiped out a cavalry of 26 people, eliciting fear from the local native people. As ominous incidents begin to unfold, they are forced to realize that this race is far more than a mere competition. The two press forward, where countless hidden motives collide..

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime, Netflix Anime, edited)

mal-61990.title: サイバーパンク: エッジランナーズ2
mal-61990.overview:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 pulls you back into Night City, where lives become entangled to the extreme. Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found. Across this ten-episode standalone series, uncover a story of family, obsession, legacy — and how your lens reflects the stories of the people around you..

When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?
(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site, Official Twitter)

mal-64534.title: 冰之城墙 第二季
mal-64534.overview:
Koyuki, the isolated girl; Miki, the former school idol; Minato, the guy with no concept of personal space; and Youta, the gentle basketball player. Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on.

As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by… 

(Source: Netflix)

mal-64254.overview:
Once dismissed as the sole ordinary student at the elite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White—secretly, the Iceblade Sorcerer—has finally earned his place. With a new school year comes a new challenge: The Magicks War, a grand competition pitting teams from rival schools against each other. But an ominous shadow looms over Ray and his friends as the other grand sorcerers plot their next moves.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-63431.english_title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
mal-63431.overview:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.
Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.
The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.
Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.
This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!
(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)

mal-64340.title: 装备我最强
mal-64340.overview:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Tempal: Item no Chikara is streaming a week in advance of the TV broadcast on Prime Video and Crunchyroll beginning September 27th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on October 2nd, 2026.

mal-61967.title: ブラッククローバー 第2期
mal-61967.overview:
As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-61987.title: 药屋少女的呢喃 第三季
mal-61987.overview:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district.

One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature.

Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation."

To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again.

From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-57612.title: 归还者的魔法要特别 第二季
mal-57612.original_title: Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu 2nd Season
mal-57612.english_title: A Returner's Magic Should be Special Season 2
mal-57612.overview:
In a land dominated by the formidable Shadow Worlds, most of humanity has been destroyed. To rescue their planet from impending doom, six brave heroes fight a perilous battle…and fail. But there’s a glimpse of hope when Desir, one of the last mages, is suddenly sent back in time 13 years! Now armed with knowledge of the grim future, can he alter the course of history and save the world?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-63337.title: FX战士久留美
mal-63337.overview:
University student Kurumi Fukuga has finally fulfilled her long-held desire of starting foreign exchange (FX) trading, motivated by recouping the 20 million yen her late mother lost in trading. "I'll easily make it back," she thought, but the world she enters can become heaven or hell in an instant. Unrealized losses, loss-cutting, unstoppable fluctuations… but she still wants to buy, sell and make money! With fellow FX addicts Mochiko, Mebuki and Yasuko along for the ride, the market heats up! Joy, despair, joy, despair — this is an endearing, yet slightly risky money game. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this turbulent world?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-61578.title: 学生会也有洞！
mal-61578.original_title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
mal-61578.english_title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
mal-61578.overview:
This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.

High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards.
However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students!

(Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)

mal-63293.title: 萤火虫的出嫁
mal-63293.overview:
On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

(Source: VIZ Media)

mal-64084.title: 世界最强的魔女，就此开始
mal-64084.overview:
After using her SSS-Rank skill, Internet, to crush her former family’s ambitions, Lorna is free to travel the world. Her next stop is the port town of Aquas, where she hopes to see the sights and chow down on some fresh seafood. But when she arrives, the place is on the brink of destruction thanks to a certain Weekly Quest… Good thing Lorna has the gods on her side!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-63382.title: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン
mal-63382.overview:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

mal-63367.title: 龙珠超 比鲁斯
mal-63367.overview:
Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep.
Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.
Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

(Source: Official Site)

Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.

Office worker Akira Yagami’s altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira’s newfound powers let him defy the species’ normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

mal-63409.overview:

Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

(Source: Yen Press)
